description: Ex RAF PM630. In the grounds of the provincial police headquarters and later a playground at Trat from 1959 to 1986, then to the RTAF workshops at Bang Sue by 1987 and restored by 1995. Owned by the Crown Prince and at Dusit Palace from 2005 to about 2010, returned to Bang Sue and rejected for further palace display because of the number of non-original parts. Parked outside the hangar since February 2014, in fighter configuration with gun pods since 2018; noted October 2025.
museum_name: Royal Thai Air Force Workshops Bang Sue
